integrity: Fully specified proof, exact integer transfer, local reconstruction and executable arithmetic checks; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts primitive two-cycle orbits, not transient basins, longer cycles, or mass-refined statistics. A general phase-cut formula and general transfer-matrix methods are prior background; novel content is the ladder-specific exact evaluation. Historical unindexed equivalents cannot be excluded. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A six-state transfer law for two-cycle orbits of parallel chip-firing on open ladders
